title: Maintain provenance and disposition for fork-specific patches
abstract: Maintain a reviewable ledger linking independently maintained fork patches to their originating change, purpose, upstream issue or commit when known, and current status such as pending, upstreamed, superseded or deliberately retained; update it when patches are changed, rebased or retired.

scope_hints.scope_boundary: Only separately authorized work on an existing Rust fork and its explicitly identified upstream; neither queueing nor this proposed requirement authorizes repository edits, upstream integrations, releases, or unrelated work.

remarks: Normalized and published as NOM-0131; no rule application or unrelated repository action.
